urgency.name: Urgent or threatening language
urgency.description: The message uses urgency or threatens an account restriction.
patterns: \b(urgent|act now|immediately|account suspended|suspended|blocked|expire|final warning)\b
\b(immediate action|respond immediately|account locked|24 hours|48 hours|final courtesy notice|last chance)\b
\b(expiring soon|action required|critical alert|security notice|unauthorized access|security breach)\b

credentials.name: Requests for sensitive information
credentials.description: The message mentions credentials or sensitive financial information.
patterns: \b(password|otp|pin|bank details|cvv|passcode|login details)\b
\b(passphrase|security code|one-time password|verification code|2fa code|mfa code|auth code)\b
\b(cvc|card number|social security|ssn|national insurance|tax id|login credentials|seed phrase|private key)\b

financial.name: Financial pressure
financial.description: The message applies pressure around a payment, transfer, or refund.
patterns: \b(send money|payment required|pay now|transfer money|refund|gift card|bank transfer)\b
\b(wire transfer|western union|moneygram|cashapp|venmo transfer|bitcoin|btc|ethereum|eth|crypto wallet|cryptocurrency payment|usdt)\b
\b(refund pending|claim refund|processing fee|tax due|overdue fee|toll fee|unpaid toll|ezpass|sunpass|invoice attached)\b

lures_and_greed.name: Suspicious reward or prize
lures_and_greed.description: The message uses reward or prize wording commonly found in lures.
patterns: \b(you have won|winner|prize|lottery|claim your reward|claim reward|free gift)\b
\b(jackpot|sweepstakes|prize notification|claim prize|exclusive reward|cash grant|unclaimed funds|inheritance|beneficiary)\b
\b(giveaway|airdrop|guaranteed return|100x profit|selected as winner|congratulations you won)\b

verification_call_to_action.name: Suspicious verification request
verification_call_to_action.description: The message asks you to verify an account or identity, or to click through.
patterns: \b(verify your account|confirm your identity|click here|tap here|open this link|verify now)\b
\b(validate your account|follow this link|update your profile|reactivate your account|restore access)\b
\b(review document|sign document|docusign document|download attachment|click below|use the link below)\b

authority_impersonation.name: Authority & Brand Impersonation
authority_impersonation.description: Spoofs well-known organizations, tech platforms, government bodies, or financial institutions.
patterns: \b(microsoft security team|apple support|google security alert)\b
\b(paypal fraud department|chase fraud alert|wells fargo security)\b
\b(usps delivery failure|fedex shipment notice|dhl customs clearance)\b
\b(internal revenue service|irs notice|department of revenue|law enforcement)\b
\b(meta security|instagram verification badge|whatsapp support team)\b
\b(geek squad|norton antivirus renewal|mcafee security subscription)\b

extortion_fear.name: Blackmail & Fear-Based Extortion
extortion_fear.description: Claims infection by spyware, recording webcam footage, or threatening public humiliation.
patterns: \b(i know your password|recorded you through your webcam|recorded video of you)\b
\b(compromised your device|pegasus spyware installed|trojan installed)\b
\b(send bitcoin or i will send|blackmail|ruin your reputation)\b
\b(warrant issued for your arrest|police warrant|court summons pending)\b

sms_toll.title: Smishing: Fake Toll Violation / SunPass Scam Lure
sms_toll.detail: Matches known SMS phishing campaigns impersonating toll services (e.g., SunPass, EZ-Pass) demanding immediate payment for unpaid tolls.

sms_package.title: Smishing: Fake Package Delivery Redelivery Scam
sms_package.detail: Matches SMS postal phishing lures impersonating USPS, FedEx, or DHL alleging an incomplete delivery address or customs fee.

sms_bank.title: Smishing: Fake Bank Debit Card Lock Alert
sms_bank.detail: Matches fraudulent SMS alerts impersonating financial institutions claiming card suspension to steal online banking logins.

social_crypto.title: Social Media Crypto / Investment Scam
social_crypto.detail: Combines cryptocurrency promotion with redirection to unmonitored channels (e.g. Telegram / WhatsApp groups), a classic trading scam pattern.

social_recovery.pattern: (?i)\b(hacked account|account recovery|recover your account|fix your account|instagram ban)\b
social_recovery.title: Account Recovery / Password Reset Scam
social_recovery.detail: Solicits victims of account lockouts or bans, falsely promising unauthorized account recovery for a fee.
